factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'Other external expenses increased by 6% compared to 2024... primarily a result of our continued commitment to invest in commercial activities, including costs for lead generation activities through an agency.' and 'Staff costs increased by 6% in 2025 compared to 2024... primarily related to new hirings and salary adjustments, while organizational adjustments in the Commercial team also had an impact.' Management commentary mentions 'balanced our cost level' and 'adjusted our commercial organization' with new CCO appointment.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'Impero's operating profit amounted to negative DKK 6.8M in 2025, which is an improvement of DKK 4.6M from negative DKK 11.4M in 2024' and 'EBITDA amounted to negative DKK 3.1M in 2025 which is an improvement of DKK 5.6M from negative DKK 8.7M in 2024.' Strategy update confirms 'significant improvement in EBITDA and lowered cash burn.'

factual_claims.claim: The improvement was supported by revenue growth outpacing increases in staff and external expenses, as well as DKK 5.2M of capitalized development costs, up from DKK 3.6M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'revenue increase of 19% compared to the lower increase in staff costs and other external expenses of 6%' and 'Activation of development costs of DKK 5.2M in 2025... This is an increase from DKK 3.6M in 2024 due to increased focus on developing new features.' Income statement notes show 'Own work capitalized' of 5,190 DKK T in 2025 vs 3,621 DKK T in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Development investment remained substantial as the company expanded its platform and launched the Control Testing module and initial AI capabilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary states 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module, advancing our AI agenda from exploration to live implementation... Our development cycles and process have matured... allowing us to deliver more impactful features more consistently.' Product milestones section details Control Testing launch and AI initiatives.

factual_claims.claim: Year-end ARR reached DKK 46.2M, up 19% from DKK 38.7M and at the upper end of the revised guidance range.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state 'At the end of 2025, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate... in line with Company Announcement No. 19-2025.' Management commentary confirms 'At the end of 2025, Impero's ARR amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to an increase of 19% compared to the end of 2024 and in line with our preliminary released 2025 ARR.'

factual_claims.claim: Momentum recovered in the second half, with fourth-quarter net new ARR of DKK 3.1M versus DKK 1.8M in the fourth quarter of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'We ended the year with a strong Q4 2025, with net new ARR of DKK 3.1M, compared to DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter in 2024.' Management commentary mentions 'improved market conditions in the second half... we delivered our best second half ever in terms of net new ARR.'

factual_claims.claim: However, full-year net new ARR declined to DKK 7.5M from DKK 8.3M, reflecting the difficult first half and delayed customer decisions through partners.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development states 'For the full year 2025, Impero's net new ARR was DKK 7.5M compared to net new ARR of DKK 8.3M in the full year 2024.' Management commentary explains 'after a net new ARR increase of only DKK 2M in the first half of 2025 following market headwinds' and 'In 2025, our partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Existing-customer performance remained strong: gross uplift was 12%, churn fell to 1% from 2%, and ARPA increased 8% to DKK 228T.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics table show 'Net uplift of 7% was driven by... gross uplift to existing customers of DKK 4.5M, corresponding to 12%' and 'In 2025, we had an exceptionally low churn of DKK 0.4M, corresponding to 1%' and 'We lifted the Average ARR per Account (ARPA) to a record high level of DKK 228T by the end of 2025... 8% above last year's level.'

factual_claims.claim: NRR decreased modestly to 106% from 108%, partly because DKK 1.8M of customer contraction included approximately DKK 1.0M from recurring service agreements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS metrics table shows Net Revenue Retention (NRR) of 106% in 2025 vs 108% in 2024. ARR development states 'The strong uplift from existing customers was partly offset by contraction of DKK 1.8M, corresponding to 5%. This was significantly affected by larger contractions stemming from recurring service agreements with a current long-standing customer, totaling approx. DKK 1.0M in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Growth was led by the DACH region, where ARR grew 26%, and Denmark, where net new ARR grew 22%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Regional development section states 'In Denmark, we increased net new ARR by a growth rate of 22% YoY... In our second core market, the DACH region, led the growth with 26% growth YoY in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: The customer base exceeded 200 customers after 26 additions, while top-10 customer concentration declined to 20% from 24%, strengthening revenue diversification.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary states 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers. During the year, we welcomed 26 new customers...' and 'Furthermore, we managed to continue improving the customer concentration among Impero's top 10 customers. Since year-end 2020, our top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Other-market ARR declined 6%, primarily because of UK contraction.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Regional development states 'ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M by the end of the year, corresponding to -6% YoY in 2025, primarily explained by a larger contraction in the UK.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow also improved, with operating cash flow of negative DKK 1.4M versus negative DKK 4.0M in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows 'Cash flow from operating activities' of -1,396 DKK T in 2025 vs -4,046 DKK T in 2024. Financial review states 'The cash burn to net new ARR ratio... fluctuated over the quarters. The year-end level of 0.9 was a significant improvement from the level in Q2 2025 and Q3 2025 of 1.5.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash ended at DKK 18.9M after a DKK 15M directed issue in December.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'The cash and cash equivalents amounted to DKK 18.9M as of 31 December 2025. In 2025, Impero had... Cash flow from financing activities was DKK 16.1M in 2025. This is primarily due to the increase in capital related to the directed issue of DKK 15M in December 2025.' Cash flow statement confirms cash and cash equivalents ending at 18,851 DKK T.

factual_claims.claim: With the stronger capital position, Impero decided to accelerate commercial investment and defer its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy update states 'With the improved capital position following the private placement in December 2025 and continued solid SaaS metrics, the Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing a strategy of being cash flow positive on a recurring basis before the end of 2026. As a result, Impero has deferred its ambition of achieving positive cash flow on a recurring basis before the end of 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: It guides for 2026 ARR of DKK 53-57M and EBITDA between negative DKK 2M and positive DKK 1M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026 section states 'By the end of 2026, Impero expects Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to reach between DKK 53M and 57M, reflecting a growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%. For 2026, EBITDA is expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to +1M due to our planned acceleration of commercial investments.'
